units.titles: INCONSISTENCY IN USER BALANCE CALCULATIONS ALLOWS FOR EXPLOITS IN WITHDRAWALS
units.known_address_notes: Halborn 2023 review of 'Substance Exchange V4', repository SubstanceExchangeV1 (private) @70064da, remediation commits 51d826b..d9201004; chain is ZetaChain (docs.substance.exchange: ZETA gas, V2 native-BTC margin). The repo is private, so the audited commit cannot be matched. Live SubstanceX on Zeta was enumerated via Blockscout: SubstanceXToken 0x436abA3B.., LiquidityPool (SLP) 0x65fb9385.. / 0xc4dE117b.. / 0x641DeAa2.., all verified after the 2023 audit, so none is provably the audited V4 ins

Decurity 2023 scope: github.com/UFarmDigital/ufarm-evm-contracts @3d87f961 (contracts/main/contracts/pool/*, PriceOracle, UnoswapV2Controller). DefiLlama's ufarm-digital adapter publishes the live 'ufarmCore' on Ethereum and Arbitrum with the same implementation; both proxies return bytecode and are verified as ERC1967Proxy, but the implementation source is not verified on either explorer and the repo's ignition/parameters.sample.json addresses (0x97076a3c..., 0x52388497...) are placeholders/tes

units.titles: check_ownable is incorrectly implemented which allows attackers to list any tokens
units.known_address_notes: Finding is in cw-std:sellable/src/execute.rs (check_ownable always Ok). The 2023 crate repo is gone (burnt-labs/cw-std, cw-nfts, cw721-sellable all 404). Burnt's live successor is xion-nft-marketplace (code_id 65, migrated path to 69) plus the asset contract (code_id 64) which carries the sellable plugin (contracts/asset/src/tests/plugin/sellable.rs in the current repo). Code IDs and instantiated contracts verified on xion-mainnet-1; the exact 2023 sellable version cannot be pinned, hence PARTIA
